channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: L.A. Firefighter Testifies Lachman Fire Still Smoldered When Crews Were Ordered to Leave
item.description: A firefighter testified that firefighters left the Lachman fire before it was completely extinguished and that could have reignited and sparked the Palisades fire.

item.title: Drawn by Fire: Heart of a Lion
item.description: Firefighters may hang up their gear, but they never hang up their warrior hearts. The courage, grit, and brotherhood stay lit long after the last alarm.

item.title: Hooks & Hoses: Vertical Fireground
item.description: What makes high-rise firefighting unique? Dave McGrail, an author and retired assistant chief from the Denver (CO) Fire Department, joins host Eric Dreiman for this episode.

item.title: Firefighters Battle 4-Alarm Fire at Historic NH Home
item.description: Fire crews in Rye responded to a four-alarm fire at a historic home, successfully containing it to the first and second floors. The cause is under investigation, with no injuries reported.

item.title: Couple, Dogs Die in MI House Fire
item.description: Two people died in a Fenton Township house fire, with first responders arriving within four minutes. The sheriff's office is investigating the cause, amid a trend of fatal house fires in Michigan.

item.title: Powering Up Preparedness: 2026 TEEX First Responder Summit Showcases Expertise on EV and Stored Energy Emergencies
item.description: Lithium-ion batteries pose unique risks for first responders, leading to the need for specialized training. The Texas A&M Engineering Extension Service is hosting a summit to address these challenges.

item.title: Man Convicted in 1988 Kansas City Firefighter Deaths Released from Prison
item.description: A federal judge granted Richard A. Brown compassionate release after nearly 29 years for his role in a 1988 arson that killed six firefighters.

item.title: Heavy Fire Rips Through OH Apartments
item.description: A fast-moving fire at the Woodbury Commons apartment complex in Parma injured two firefighters and displaced residents. The cause is under investigation, with no residents requiring medical treatment.

item.title: TX Firefighter Dies Battling Grass Fire
item.description: Firefighter Jeff Derrick, 67, died after becoming disoriented and overcome by smoke while battling a grass fire, according to reports.

item.title: Two Hospitalized in ‘Treacherous’ Apartment Building Fire in NY
item.description: A fire at Syracuse's Nob Hill Apartments hospitalized two people and caused extensive damage. The complex faces ongoing issues, including code violations and tenant complaints about living conditions.
